  • bary-vertices — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], (real-part(1) * goua_ + imag-part(1) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(1) - imag-part(1)) * gouc_ = goua_ and (real-part(1i) * goua_ + imag-part(1i) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(1i) - imag-part(1i)) * gouc_ = goub_ and (real-part(0) * goua_ + imag-part(0) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(0) - imag-part(0)) * gouc_ = gouc_)
  • bdd-fn-le-arg — forall([t in rr], 0 <= t implies (/)(t, 1 + t) <= t)

  • cauchy-derivative-formula — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([cierho_ in rr], 0 < cierho_ implies cierho_ < r implies forall([k in nn], (nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_), restrict(f, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_)), k))(c) = factorial(k) * (recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))))
  • cauchy-disc — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset ball(cc-ms, c, r) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))

  • cauchy-estimate-center — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies magnitude(f(c)) <= ciebd_))))
  • cauchy-estimate-circle — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)) <= ciebd_ * recip(r) ^ k)))))
  • cauchy-estimate-derivative — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([cierho_ in rr], 0 < cierho_ implies cierho_ < r implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude((nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_), restrict(f, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_)), k))(c)) <= factorial(k) * (ciebd_ * recip(r) ^ k)))))))

  • cauchy-integral-formula-centre — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies forall([cmvbr_ in rr], r < cmvbr_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cmvbr_) subset u implies f(c) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(cmvw_, difference(u, singleton(c)), f(cmvw_) * recip(cmvw_ - c)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi))))

  • cauchy-integral-formula-disc-restrict — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))
  • cauchy-kernel-constant-magnitude — magnitude(recip((2 * pi) * 1i)) = recip(2 * pi)

  • cauchy-kernel-series-absolute — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, magnitude(line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b) * (z - c) ^ aitk_)))))
  • cauchy-rapid-subsequence — forall([s, f, rad], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) and rad in fun(nn, rr) and forall([k in nn], pos-rr(rad(k))) implies forsome([phi in fun(nn, nn)], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], m < n_ implies phi(m) < phi(n_)) and forall([k in nn], (dist(s))(f(phi(k)), f(phi(succ(k)))) <= rad(k))))

  • cc-circle-arg — forall([cxsa_ in rr, cxsb_ in rr], cxsa_ ^ 2 + cxsb_ ^ 2 = 1 implies forsome([cxsth_ in rr], -pi <= cxsth_ and cxsth_ < pi and cc-cos(cxsth_) = cxsa_ and cc-sin(cxsth_) = cxsb_))

  • cc-continuous-at-iff-coords — forall([s, f, fr, fi, a], is-metric-space(s) implies f in fun(pts(s), cc) implies fr in fun(pts(s), rr) implies fi in fun(pts(s), rr) implies a in pts(s) implies forall([u_ in pts(s)], real-part(f(u_)) = fr(u_)) implies forall([u_ in pts(s)], imag-part(f(u_)) = fi(u_)) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, f, a) iff is-continuous-at(s, rr-ms, fr, a) and is-continuous-at(s, rr-ms, fi, a))

  • cc-converges-iff-coords — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), g in fun(nn, rr), q_ in fun(nn, rr), lv in cc], forall([n_ in nn], real-part(f(n_)) = g(n_)) implies forall([n_ in nn], imag-part(f(n_)) = q_(n_)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, f, lv) iff converges-to(rr-ms, g, real-part(lv)) and converges-to(rr-ms, q_, imag-part(lv)))

  • cc-diff-at-cc-mul — forall([cv in cc, g in fun(rr, cc), pd in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], pd(x_) = cv * g(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(pd, tv_, cv * lv))

  • cc-diff-at-difference — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), h in fun(rr, cc), sb_ in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc, mv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], sb_(x_) = g(x_) - h(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(h, tv_, mv) implies is-cc-diff-at(sb_, tv_, lv - mv))

  • compose-type-5 — forall([x, f, g, h, k, m, a], f in fun(x) implies g in fun(ran(f)) implies h in fun(ran(g)) implies k in fun(ran(h)) implies m in fun(ran(k)) implies a in x implies m(k(h(g(f(a))))) in ran(m))

  • cont-on-transfer-ptwise-eq — forall([itdm_], itdm_ subset rr implies forall([f, itg_], f in fun(itdm_, rr) implies is-continuous-on(itg_, itdm_) implies forall([itz_ in itdm_], f(itz_) = itg_(itz_)) implies is-continuous-on(f, itdm_)))
  • cont-transfer-ptwise-eq — forall([f, g, a], f in fun(rr, rr) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, a) implies forall([x in rr], f(x) = g(x)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, a))
  • continuous-abs-bounded-on-ccint — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([m_ in rr], 0 <= m_ and forall([z_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(f(z_)) <= m_)))
  • continuous-at-iff-sequential — forall([s, t, f, a], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies a in pts(s) implies is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a) iff forall([sq in sqn(pts(s))], converges-to(s, sq, a) implies converges-to(t, compose(f, sq), f(a))))

  • continuous-at-local — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), g in fun(rr, rr), t_ in rr, rho in rr], 0 < rho implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, t_) implies forall([x_ in rr], abs(x_ - t_) <= rho implies f(x_) = g(x_)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, t_))

  • continuous-image-of-compact — forall([s, t, fqf_], is-continuous(s, t, fqf_) implies forall([aqa_], aqa_ subset pts(s) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(s, aqa_)) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(t, image(fqf_, aqa_)))))

  • continuous-on-implies-regulated-on — forall([f, a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies is-regulated-on(f, a, b))
  • continuous-on-left-limit-within — forall([f, rqw_], rqw_ subset rr implies is-continuous-on(f, rqw_) implies forall([rqx_ in rqw_], is-left-limit-within(f, rqw_, rqx_, f(rqx_))))

  • continuous-uniformly-continuous-on-ccint — forall([f, a, b, eps], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies pos-rr(eps) implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([d_ in rr], 0 < d_ and forall([p_ in ccint(a, b), q_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(p_ - q_) <= d_ implies abs(f(p_) - f(q_)) <= eps)))
  • conv3-avoids-vertex — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc], not(imag-part((goxb_ - goxa_) * conjugate(goxc_ - goxa_)) = 0) implies forall([goxt_ in rr], 0 < goxt_ implies goxt_ <= 1 implies not(goxa_ in conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxb_, goxc_)) and not(goxa_ in conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxc_, goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxc_ - goxa_)))))

  • conv3-intro — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goul_ in ccint(0, 1), goum_ in ccint(0, 1), goun_ in ccint(0, 1), gouz_], (goul_ + goum_) + goun_ = 1 implies gouz_ = (goul_ * goua_ + goum_ * goub_) + goun_ * gouc_ implies gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))

  • conv3-sub-triangle — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], conv3(goua_, cc-mid(goua_, goub_), cc-mid(goua_, gouc_)) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and conv3(cc-mid(goua_, goub_), goub_, cc-mid(goub_, gouc_)) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and conv3(cc-mid(goua_, gouc_), cc-mid(goub_, gouc_), gouc_) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and conv3(cc-mid(goua_, goub_), cc-mid(goub_, gouc_), cc-mid(goua_, gouc_)) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))

  • conv3-vertices-in — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], goua_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and goub_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and gouc_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
  • convergence-block-tower — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([n in nn], seq-compact(ms(n))) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms))], forsome([s in fun(nn, inf-subsets(nn))], forall([k in nn], s(succ(k)) subset s(k)) and forsome([l in product-carrier(ms)], forall([n in nn], converges-along(ms(n), vnb-lambda(i, nn, (seq(i))(n)), s(n), l(n)))))))

  • coordinatewise-diagonal-subseq — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([n in nn], seq-compact(ms(n))) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms))], forsome([delta], strictly-mono-nn(delta) and forsome([l in product-carrier(ms)], forall([n in nn], converges-to(ms(n), vnb-lambda(k, nn, ((subseq(seq, delta))(k))(n)), l(n)))))))
  • countable-cases — forall([rqd_], is-countable(rqd_) implies rqd_ in set and (rqd_ = empty-set or forsome([rqe_ in fun(nn, rqd_)], forall([rqy_ in rqd_], forsome([rqn_ in nn], rqy_ = rqe_(rqn_))))))

  • countable-of-two-enum — forall([rqu_, rqf_, rqg_], rqu_ in set implies rqf_ in fun(nn, rqu_) implies rqg_ in fun(nn, rqu_) implies forall([rqy_ in rqu_], forsome([rqj_ in nn], rqy_ = rqf_(rqj_)) or forsome([rqj_ in nn], rqy_ = rqg_(rqj_))) implies is-countable(rqu_))

  • cover-block-step — forall([v in set, f in fun(nn, v), c], is-finite-cover(c, v) implies forall([j in inf-subsets(nn)], forsome([j_ in inf-subsets(nn)], j_ subset j and forsome([u in c], forall([i in j_], f(i) in u)))))
  • cpd-cc-squeeze — forall([s_ in fun(nn, cc), lv in cc, m in fun(nn, rr)], converges-to(rr-ms, m, 0) implies forall([cpdj_ in nn], magnitude(s_(cpdj_) - lv) <= m(cpdj_)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, s_, lv))

  • cps-converges-closed-ball — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpsrad_ in rr], 0 <= cpsrad_ implies cpsrad_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forall([cpsz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, cpsrad_)], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpsz_ ^ cpsk_))))
  • cps-diff-on-ball — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), dcf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], dcf(cpdj_) = succ(cpdj_) * cf(succ(cpdj_))) implies forall([cpdr_ in rr], 0 < cpdr_ implies cpdr_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forall([cpda_ in ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_)], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))), cpda_, cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, dcf(cpsk_) * cpda_ ^ cpsk_))))))
  • cps-entire-converges — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc)], cps-radius(cf) = pos-inf implies forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cexz_ ^ cpsk_))))

  • lfe-coef-unique — forall([m, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies v in vec(m) implies forall([a_ in rr, b_ in rr], (act(m))(a_, v) = (act(m))(b_, v) implies a_ * (vnrm(m))(v) = b_ * (vnrm(m))(v)))

  • lincomb-row-peel — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n in nn, c in mat(1, succ(n), carr(scal(md))), u in mat(succ(n), 1, vec(md))], lincomb(md, succ(n), c, u) = (vadd(md))(lincomb(md, n, block(c, 1, n), block(u, n, 1)), (act(md))(entry(c, 1, succ(n)), entry(u, succ(n), 1)))))

  • line-int-affine-reparam — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([lrpr_, lrpk_], lrpr_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies lrpk_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpr_(lrpz_) == pgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpk_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * dgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies line-int(f, lrpr_, lrpk_, lrpc_, lrpd_) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b))))

  • line-int-concat — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, prho, drho, a, b, c, d], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies is-road(prho, drho, c, d) implies pgam(b) = prho(c) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies trace(prho, c, d) subset u implies line-int(f, juxta(pgam, vnb-lambda(jxs_, ccint(b, b + d - c), prho(c + jxs_ - b)), a, b, b + d - c), juxta(dgam, vnb-lambda(jxs_, ccint(b, b + d - c), drho(c + jxs_ - b)), a, b, b + d - c), a, b + d - c) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) + line-int(f, prho, drho, c, d))
  • line-int-domain-congruence — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([wnv_, wng_ in fun(wnv_, cc)], trace(pgam, a, b) subset wnv_ implies forall([wnx_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], wng_(wnx_) == f(wnx_)) implies line-int(wng_, pgam, dgam, a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b))))
  • line-int-exists — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forsome([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) and is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b)))
  • line-int-in-cc — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) in cc)

  • line-int-interior-congruence — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([qgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc), qdg in fun(ccint(a, b), cc)], forall([t in ccint(a, b)], qgam(t) == pgam(t)) implies forall([t in ooint(a, b)], qdg(t) == dgam(t)) implies line-int(f, qgam, qdg, a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
  • line-int-juxta — forall([u, f, pgam1, dgam1, pgam2, dgam2, a, b, c], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam1, dgam1, a, b) implies is-road(pgam2, dgam2, b, c) implies pgam1(b) = pgam2(b) implies trace(pgam1, a, b) subset u implies trace(pgam2, b, c) subset u implies line-int(f, juxta(pgam1, pgam2, a, b, c), juxta(dgam1, dgam2, a, b, c), a, c) = line-int(f, pgam1, dgam1, a, b) + line-int(f, pgam2, dgam2, b, c))
  • line-int-length-bound — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([bnd in rr], forall([bny_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(f(bny_)) <= bnd) implies magnitude(line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= road-length(dgam, a, b) * bnd))
  • line-int-of-derivative — forall([u, f, df, pgam, dgam, a, b], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies df in fun(u, cc) implies forall([hbz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, hbz_, df(hbz_))) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies line-int(df, pgam, dgam, a, b) = f(pgam(b)) - f(pgam(a)))
  • line-int-of-one — forall([pgam, dgam, a, b, pf, pad_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies forall([pay_ in pad_], pf(pay_) = 1) implies line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b) = pgam(b) - pgam(a))

  • line-int-opposite — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pgam, dgam, pf, pad_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies forall([prgb_, prdb_], prgb_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies prdb_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prgb_(pay_) == pgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prdb_(pay_) == -1 * dgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) implies line-int(pf, prgb_, prdb_, a, b) = -1 * line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b)))))

  • road-affine-reparam — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([pgam, dgam, lrpr_, lrpk_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies lrpr_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies lrpk_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpr_(lrpz_) == pgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpk_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * dgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies is-road(lrpr_, lrpk_, lrpc_, lrpd_)))

  • road-length-affine-reparam — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([pgam, dgam, lrpk_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies lrpk_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpk_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * dgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies road-length(lrpk_, lrpc_, lrpd_) = road-length(dgam, a, b)))

  • rolle-on-interval — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([h in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(h, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([x in ooint(a, b)], forsome([l], has-deriv-at(h, x, l))) implies h(a) = h(b) implies forsome([theta in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(h, theta, 0))))
  • root-test — forall([cpsth_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= cpsth_(cpsk_)) implies (elimsup(vnb-lambda(cpsj_, nn, rpow-star(cpsth_(cpsj_), recip-star(cpsj_)))) < 1 implies series-converges(cpsth_)) and (1 < elimsup(vnb-lambda(cpsj_, nn, rpow-star(cpsth_(cpsj_), recip-star(cpsj_)))) implies not(series-converges(cpsth_))))
  • root-test-converges — forall([cpsth_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= cpsth_(cpsk_)) implies elimsup(vnb-lambda(cpsj_, nn, rpow-star(cpsth_(cpsj_), recip-star(cpsj_)))) < 1 implies series-converges(cpsth_))
  • root-test-diverges — forall([cpsth_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= cpsth_(cpsk_)) implies 1 < elimsup(vnb-lambda(cpsj_, nn, rpow-star(cpsth_(cpsj_), recip-star(cpsj_)))) implies not(series-converges(cpsth_)))
  • row-tabulation — forall([n in nn, a, g, c_], forall([j_], j_ in nn and 1 <= j_ and j_ <= n implies g(c_, j_) in a) implies forsome([l in tuples(a)], length(l) = n and forall([j_], j_ in nn and 1 <= j_ and j_ <= n implies nth(j_, l) = g(c_, j_))))

  • rpow-add — forall([a], a in rr and 0 < a implies forall([b in qq, d in qq], rpow(a, b + d) = rpow(a, b) * rpow(a, d)))

  • rpow-mul-base — forall([a], a in rr and 0 < a implies forall([c], c in rr and 0 < c implies forall([b in qq], rpow(a * c, b) = rpow(a, b) * rpow(c, b))))

  • rpow-star-mono-base — forall([x_, y_, s_], x_ in rr implies y_ in rr implies s_ in rr implies 0 < x_ implies x_ < y_ implies 0 < s_ implies rpow-star(x_, s_) < rpow-star(y_, s_))

  • rpow-star-mul-base — forall([x_, y_, s_], x_ in rr implies y_ in rr implies s_ in rr implies 0 < x_ implies 0 < y_ implies rpow-star(x_ * y_, s_) = rpow-star(x_, s_) * rpow-star(y_, s_))

  • rps-finsum-scale-ptwise — forall([c in rr], 0 <= c implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f, h], forall([z_ in s], f(z_) in rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in s], h(z_) = etimes(c, f(z_))) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, h, s) = etimes(c, finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s)))))

  • rq-mul-computes — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a, b], a in carr(r) implies b in carr(r) implies (mul(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)))(class(ringoid-setoid(r), a), class(ringoid-setoid(r), b)) = class(ringoid-setoid(r), (mul(r))(a, b))))

  • seg-curve-in-fun — forall([m, f, a, eta], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies f in fun(vec(m), rr) implies a in vec(m) implies eta in vec(m) implies seg-curve(m, f, a, eta) in fun(rr, rr))
  • seg-deriv-bridge — forall([goua_, goub_, gouw_], goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies seg-deriv(goua_, goub_) == vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), gouw_))
  • seg-image-insert — forall([n_ in nn, b_, g_ in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n_)), b_)], b_ = union(image(g_, ord-segment(n_)), pair(g_(n_), g_(n_))))

  • seg-int-bridge — forall([f, goua_, goub_, goup_, gouw_], goua_ = goup_ implies goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) == line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), goup_ + psx_ * gouw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), gouw_), 0, 1))
  • seg-int-congruence — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goxw_, goxg_ in fun(goxw_, cc), goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goxa_, goxb_), 0, 1) subset u implies trace(seg-path(goxa_, goxb_), 0, 1) subset goxw_ implies forall([goxz_ in trace(seg-path(goxa_, goxb_), 0, 1)], goxg_(goxz_) == f(goxz_)) implies seg-int(goxg_, goxa_, goxb_) = seg-int(f, goxa_, goxb_)))
  • seg-int-const — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([goup_ in cc, gouw_ in cc, goug_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([gouz_ in u], goug_(gouz_) == goup_ + 0 * (gouz_ - gouw_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(goug_, goua_, goub_) = goup_ * (goub_ - goua_))))
  • seg-int-degenerate — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([gouz_ in u], seg-int(f, gouz_, gouz_) = 0))
  • seg-int-in-cc — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) in cc))
  • seg-int-reverse-at — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(f, goub_, goua_) = -1 * seg-int(f, goua_, goub_)))
  • seg-int-split-at — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies forall([gouc_ in trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1)], seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) = seg-int(f, goua_, gouc_) + seg-int(f, gouc_, goub_))))
  • seg-int-sum — forall([u, f, g], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([gouh_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([gouz_ in u], gouh_(gouz_) == f(gouz_) + g(gouz_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(gouh_, goua_, goub_) = seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) + seg-int(g, goua_, goub_))))
  • seg-int-unfold — forall([f, goua_, goub_], seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) == line-int(f, seg-path(goua_, goub_), seg-deriv(goua_, goub_), 0, 1))
  • seg-mem-lt — forall([n_ in nn, j_ in nn], j_ in ord-segment(n_) iff j_ < n_)
  • seg-mem-succ-le — forall([n_ in nn, j_ in nn], j_ in ord-segment(succ(n_)) iff j_ <= n_)
  • seg-path-apply — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gout_ in ccint(0, 1)], (seg-path(goua_, goub_))(gout_) = goua_ + gout_ * (goub_ - goua_))
  • seg-path-bridge — forall([goua_, goub_, goup_, gouw_], goua_ = goup_ implies goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies seg-path(goua_, goub_) == vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), goup_ + psx_ * gouw_))
  • seg-path-is-road — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], is-road(seg-path(goua_, goub_), seg-deriv(goua_, goub_), 0, 1))
  • seg-perm-restrict-is-bijection — forall([n in nn, phi in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n)), ord-segment(succ(n))), k], phi(n) = k implies vnb-lambda(i_, ord-segment(n), if(phi(i_) = n, k, phi(i_))) in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n)))
  • seg-restrict-is-bijection — forall([n_ in nn, b_, g_ in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n_)), b_)], vnb-lambda(i_, ord-segment(n_), g_(i_)) in bijection(ord-segment(n_), image(g_, ord-segment(n_))))
  • seg-shift-is-road — forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies is-road(vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-path(p, q))(trs_ - k)), vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-deriv(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m))
  • seg-shift-length — forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies road-length(vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-deriv(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m) = magnitude(q - p))
  • seg-shift-line-int — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies trace(seg-path(p, q), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-path(p, q))(trs_ - k)), vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-deriv(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m) = line-int(f, seg-path(p, q), seg-deriv(p, q), 0, 1)))
  • seg-shift-trace — forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies trace(vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-path(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m) = trace(seg-path(p, q), 0, 1))
  • seg-trace-bridge — forall([goua_, goub_, goup_, gouw_], goua_ = goup_ implies goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) == trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), goup_ + psx_ * gouw_), 0, 1))
  • seg-trace-elim — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouz_ in trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1)], forsome([gout_ in ccint(0, 1)], gouz_ = goua_ + gout_ * (goub_ - goua_)))
  • seg-trace-in-conv3 — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and trace(seg-path(goub_, gouc_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and trace(seg-path(gouc_, goua_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
  • seg-trace-in-convex — forall([u], is-convex(u) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], goua_ in u implies goub_ in u implies trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u))
  • seg-trace-intro — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gout_ in ccint(0, 1)], goua_ + gout_ * (goub_ - goua_) in trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1))
  • seg0-empty — empty-set = ord-segment(0)
  • segment-int-abs-bound — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies forall([lrpn_ in rr], forall([lrpy_ in trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1)], magnitude(f(lrpy_)) <= lrpn_) implies magnitude(line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1)) <= magnitude(pzw_) * lrpn_)))
  • segment-int-reverse — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (pz0_ + pzw_) + psx_ * (-1 * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), -1 * pzw_), 0, 1) = -1 * line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1)))
  • segment-int-split — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc, lrpt_ in ooint(0, 1)], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1) = line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * (lrpt_ * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), lrpt_ * pzw_), 0, 1) + line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (pz0_ + lrpt_ * pzw_) + psx_ * ((1 - lrpt_) * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (1 - lrpt_) * pzw_), 0, 1)))
  • segment-is-road — forall([pz0_, pzw_], pz0_ in cc implies pzw_ in cc implies is-road(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1))
  • sep-fiber-insert-other — forall([s, x, phi, z], x in set implies not(phi(x) = z) implies {fw_ in union(s, pair(x, x)): phi(fw_) = z} = {fw_ in s: phi(fw_) = z})
  • sep-fiber-insert-same — forall([s, x, phi], x in set implies phi(x) in set implies {fw_ in union(s, pair(x, x)): phi(fw_) = phi(x)} = union({fw_ in s: phi(fw_) = phi(x)}, pair(x, x)))
  • seq-compact-countable-product — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([n in nn], seq-compact(ms(n))) implies seq-compact(product-metric(ms)))
  • seq-compact-image — forall([md, mt, cmf_], is-metric-space(md) implies is-metric-space(mt) implies is-continuous(md, mt, cmf_) implies seq-compact(md) implies seq-compact(subspace-ms(mt, image(cmf_, pts(md)))))
  • seq-compact-implies-compact — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies seq-compact(s) implies is-compact(s))
  • seq-compact-implies-totally-bounded — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies seq-compact(s) implies totally-bounded(s))
  • seq-limit-converges-to — forall([f], converges(rr-ms, f) implies converges-to(rr-ms, f, seq-limit(f)))
  • seq-limit-in-rr — forall([f], seq-limit(f) in rr)
  • seq-limit-value — forall([f, lv], converges-to(rr-ms, f, lv) implies seq-limit(f) = lv)
  • sequential-implies-continuous-at — forall([s, t, f, a], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies a in pts(s) implies forall([sq in sqn(pts(s))], converges-to(s, sq, a) implies converges-to(t, compose(f, sq), f(a))) implies is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a))
  • series-abs-converges — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(f))
  • series-abs-triangle — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, k)) <= series-partial-sum(g, k))
  • series-abs-triangle-block — forall([d in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, m + d) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= series-partial-sum(g, m + d) - series-partial-sum(g, m))
  • series-abs-triangle-le — forall([k in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies m <= k implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, k) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, m))
  • series-block-le — forall([k in nn, n_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_) and f(i_) <= g(i_)) implies n_ <= k implies series-partial-sum(f, k) - series-partial-sum(f, n_) <= series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, n_))
  • series-bounded-converges — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsb_ in rr], forall([cpsk_ in nn], series-partial-sum(f, cpsk_) <= cpsb_) implies series-converges(f)))
  • series-cauchy-criterion — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([bnd in nn], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], bnd <= m and m <= n_ implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, n_) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= eps))))
  • series-converges-sum — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= g(i_)) implies forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(h))
  • series-converges-to-add — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr, mv in rr], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges-to(g, mv) implies series-converges-to(h, lv + mv))
  • series-converges-to-converges — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr], series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges(f))
  • series-dominated-partial-bound — forall([cpdk_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= g(cpdj_)) implies forall([cpdn_ in nn], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdn_ <= cpdj_ implies f(cpdj_) <= g(cpdj_)) implies series-partial-sum(f, cpdk_) <= series-partial-sum(f, cpdn_) + series-partial-sum(g, cpdk_))))
  • series-eventually-dominated-converges — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= g(cpdj_)) implies forall([cpdn_ in nn], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdn_ <= cpdj_ implies f(cpdj_) <= g(cpdj_)) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(f))))
  • series-eventually-geometric-converges — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsq_ in rr], 0 <= cpsq_ implies cpsq_ < 1 implies forall([cpsc_ in rr], 0 <= cpsc_ implies forall([cpsn_ in nn], forall([cpsk_ in nn], cpsn_ <= cpsk_ implies f(cpsk_) <= cpsc_ * cpsq_ ^ cpsk_) implies series-converges(f)))))
  • series-frequently-large-diverges — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), cpsc_ in rr], 0 < cpsc_ implies forall([cpsn_ in nn], forsome([cpsk_ in nn], cpsn_ <= cpsk_ and cpsc_ <= f(cpsk_))) implies not(series-converges(f)))
  • series-head-null — forall([n_ in nn, u], forall([j_ in nn], u(j_) in fun(nn, rr)) implies forall([i_ in nn], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (u(j_))(i_)), 0)) implies forall([hd in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j_ in nn], hd(j_) = series-partial-sum(u(j_), n_)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, hd, 0)))
  • series-limit-add — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(g) implies series-limit(h) = series-limit(f) + series-limit(g))
  • series-limit-converges-to — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies series-converges-to(f, series-limit(f)))
  • series-limit-in-rr — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies series-limit(f) in rr)
  • series-limit-iota — forall([f], iota(l, series-converges-to(f, l)) == series-limit(f))
  • series-limit-le — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr, mv in rr], forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) <= g(n_)) implies series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges-to(g, mv) implies lv <= mv)
  • series-nonneg-zero-sum — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], 0 <= f(n_)) implies series-converges-to(f, 0) implies forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) = 0))
  • series-partial-sum-abs-le — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], abs(series-partial-sum(f, k)) <= series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, abs(f(n_))), k))
  • series-partial-sum-add — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-partial-sum(h, k) = series-partial-sum(f, k) + series-partial-sum(g, k))
  • series-partial-sum-add-ptwise — forall([n_ in nn, f_, g_, h_], forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], g_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = f_(k_) + g_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(h_, n_) = series-partial-sum(f_, n_) + series-partial-sum(g_, n_))
  • series-partial-sum-agree-below — forall([n in nn, tcu_, tcg_], forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < n implies tcg_(tck_) in rr) implies forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < n implies tcu_(tck_) = tcg_(tck_)) implies series-partial-sum(tcu_, n) = series-partial-sum(tcg_, n))
  • series-partial-sum-antiderivable — forall([n_ in nn, s_, ph_, a, b], a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies ph_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([j_ in nn], is-antiderivable(s_(j_), a, b)) implies forall([x_ in rr], ph_(x_) == series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (s_(j_))(x_)), n_)) implies is-antiderivable(ph_, a, b))
  • series-partial-sum-bounded — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies forsome([bnd in rr], forall([kx in nn], series-partial-sum(f, kx) <= bnd)))

  • step-pieces-append — forall([rsp_, rsn_, rsh_, rsq_, rsg_, rsc_, rsd_, rsk_], rsp_ in fun(nn, rr) implies rsn_ in nn implies rsh_ in fun(rr, rr) implies rsq_ in fun(nn, rr) implies rsg_ in fun(rr, rr) implies rsc_ in rr implies rsd_ in rr implies rsk_ in rr implies forall([rsi_, rsj_], rsi_ in interval(0, rsn_) and rsj_ in interval(0, rsn_) and rsi_ < rsj_ implies rsp_(rsi_) < rsp_(rsj_)) implies forall([rspi_], rspi_ in interval(0, rsn_) and rspi_ < rsn_ implies forsome([rspc_ in rr], forall([rspt_], rspt_ in rr and rsp_(rspi_) < rspt_ and rspt_ < rsp_(succ(rspi_)) implies rsh_(rspt_) = rspc_))) implies rsp_(rsn_) = rsc_ implies forall([rsj_ in nn], rsj_ <= rsn_ implies rsq_(rsj_) = rsp_(rsj_)) implies rsq_(succ(rsn_)) = rsd_ implies forall([rst_ in rr], rst_ <= rsc_ implies rsg_(rst_) = rsh_(rst_)) implies forall([rst_ in rr], rsc_ < rst_ implies rst_ < rsd_ implies rsg_(rst_) = rsk_) implies forall([rspi_], rspi_ in interval(0, succ(rsn_)) and rspi_ < succ(rsn_) implies forsome([rspc_ in rr], forall([rspt_], rspt_ in rr and rsq_(rspi_) < rspt_ and rspt_ < rsq_(succ(rspi_)) implies rsg_(rspt_) = rspc_))))

  • submodule-fg — forall([md], is-module(md) and is-euclidean-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([n in nn, u in mat(n, 1, vec(md))], generates(md, n, u) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forsome([k], (k in nn and k <= n) and forsome([w in mat(k, 1, vec(md))], spans(md, k, w, sm))))))
  • submodule-finsum-closed — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(module-vector-ag(md)))], forall([z in s], f(z) in sm) implies finsum(module-vector-ag(md), f, s) in sm))))

  • sum-ag-act-collect-ind — forall([n in nn, md], is-module(md) implies forall([x in vec(md), gc_, gv_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gc_(i_) in carr(scal(md))) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gv_(i_) == (act(md))(gc_(i_), x)) implies sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), gv_, n) = (act(md))(sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(scal(md)), gc_, n), x)))

  • sum-ag-all-id-ind — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = iden(ag)))

  • sum-ag-comm-monoid-type-ind — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m))], sum-ag(m, f, n) in carr(m)))
  • sum-ag-comm-monoid-type-ptwise — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in carr(m)) implies sum-ag(m, g_, n) in carr(m)))
  • sum-ag-fubini-ind — forall([m in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, ff_, gg_, rs_, cs_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(m), j_ in ord-segment(n)], (ff_(i_))(j_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(m), j_ in ord-segment(n)], (gg_(j_))(i_) == (ff_(i_))(j_)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(m)], rs_(i_) == sum-ag(ag, ff_(i_), n)) implies forall([j_ in ord-segment(n)], cs_(j_) == sum-ag(ag, gg_(j_), m)) implies sum-ag(ag, rs_, m) = sum-ag(ag, cs_, n)))
  • sum-ag-in-subset-ind — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([sm], iden(ag) in sm implies forall([x_ in sm, y_ in sm], (opr(ag))(x_, y_) in sm) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in sm) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) in sm)))
  • sum-ag-permutation-invariance — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(ag)), h in fun(nn, carr(ag)), phi in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], h(i) = g(phi(i))) implies sum-ag(ag, g, n) = sum-ag(ag, h, n))) [warrant: informal]
  • sum-ag-permutation-invariance-laws — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s)), h in fun(nn, carr(s)), phi in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], h(i) = g(phi(i))) implies sum-ag(s, g, n) = sum-ag(s, h, n)))
  • sum-ag-replace-entry-laws — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s)), gp in fun(nn, carr(s)), k in ord-segment(n)], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = k) implies g(i_) == gp(i_)) implies (opr(s))(sum-ag(s, g, n), gp(k)) = (opr(s))(sum-ag(s, gp, n), g(k))))
  • sum-ag-ring-left-ind — forall([n in nn, rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(rng)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (mul(rng))(r, ga_(i_))) implies sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), gb_, n) = (mul(rng))(r, sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), ga_, n))))
  • sum-ag-ring-right-ind — forall([n in nn, rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(rng)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (mul(rng))(ga_(i_), r)) implies sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), gb_, n) = (mul(rng))(sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), ga_, n), r)))
  • sum-ag-rr-in-rr — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f, k) in rr)
  • sum-ag-segment-congruence — forall([n in nn, ag, g, h], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], g(i) == h(i)) implies sum-ag(ag, g, n) == sum-ag(ag, h, n))
  • sum-ag-single-ind — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_, p_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(p_) in carr(ag) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = p_) implies g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = g_(p_)))
  • sum-ag-two-support-ind — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_, p_, q_], p_ in ord-segment(n) implies q_ in ord-segment(n) implies not(p_ = q_) implies g_(p_) in carr(ag) implies g_(q_) in carr(ag) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = p_) implies not(i_ = q_) implies g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = (opr(ag))(g_(p_), g_(q_))))
  • sum-ag-type — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag)), n in nn], sum-ag(ag, f, n) in carr(ag)))
  • sum-ag-type-ind — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag))], sum-ag(ag, f, n) in carr(ag)))
  • sum-ag-type-laws — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s))], sum-ag(s, g, n) in carr(s)))
  • sum-ag-type-ptwise — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in carr(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) in carr(ag)))
  • sum-continuous-at — forall([g, h, a], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, h, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(x, rr, g(x) + h(x)), a))
  • sum-expansion — forall([n in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r), g in fun(zz, carr(r))], sum(r, vnb-lambda(k, zz, (add(r))((mul(r))(x, g(k - 1)), (mul(r))(y, g(k)))), succ(n)) = (add(r))((add(r))((mul(r))((add(r))(x, y), sum(r, g, n)), (mul(r))(x, g(0 - 1))), (mul(r))(y, g(n)))))
  • sum-in-carr-zz-ind — forall([n_ in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([g in fun(zz, carr(r))], sum(r, g, n_) in carr(r)))

  • sum-set-disjoint-union-defined — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([x, s1, s2, f], x in set and s1 in set and s2 in set and intersection(s1, s2) = empty-set and union(s1, s2) subset x and f in fun(x, carr(r)) and card(s1) in nn and card(s2) in nn implies sum-set(r, union(s1, s2), f) = (add(r))(sum-set(r, s1, f), sum-set(r, s2, f))))
  • sum-set-empty — forall([r, f], sum-set(r, empty-set, f) == zero(r))
  • sum-set-left-scalar — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([f in fun(x, carr(s))], (mul(s))(a, sum-set(s, x, f)) = sum-set(s, x, vnb-lambda(z, x, (mul(s))(a, f(z)))))))
  • sum-set-right-scalar — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([b in carr(s), x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([f in fun(x, carr(s))], (mul(s))(sum-set(s, x, f), b) = sum-set(s, x, vnb-lambda(z, x, (mul(s))(f(z), b))))))
  • sum-set-singleton-defined — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([x in set, f], f(x) in carr(r) implies sum-set(r, pair(x, x), f) = f(x)))

  • trace-affine-reparam — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([pgam, lrpr_], pgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies lrpr_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpr_(lrpz_) == pgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies trace(lrpr_, lrpc_, lrpd_) subset trace(pgam, a, b) and trace(pgam, a, b) subset trace(lrpr_, lrpc_, lrpd_)))

  • tri-child-geom-3 — forall([goux_ in cc, gouy_ in cc, gouz_ in cc], (magnitude(cc-mid(gouy_, gouz_) - cc-mid(goux_, gouz_)) + magnitude(gouz_ - cc-mid(gouy_, gouz_))) + magnitude(cc-mid(goux_, gouz_) - gouz_) = 1/2 * ((magnitude(gouy_ - goux_) + magnitude(gouz_ - gouy_)) + magnitude(goux_ - gouz_)) and magnitude(cc-mid(goux_, gouz_) - goux_) <= (magnitude(gouy_ - goux_) + magnitude(gouz_ - gouy_)) + magnitude(goux_ - gouz_))

  • tri-int-abs-bound — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) subset u implies forall([goum_ in rr], forall([gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)], magnitude(f(gouz_)) <= goum_) implies magnitude(tri-int(f, goua_, goub_, gouc_)) <= ((magnitude(goub_ - goua_) + magnitude(gouc_ - goub_)) + magnitude(goua_ - gouc_)) * goum_)))

  • zen-enum-injective — forall([al in ord, s in set], forall([cz], ord-lt(cz, al) implies forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, cz) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})) implies forall([a1_ in ord-segment(al), a2_ in ord-segment(al)], (vnb-lambda(a_, ord-segment(al), zen(s, a_)))(a1_) = (vnb-lambda(a_, ord-segment(al), zen(s, a_)))(a2_) implies a1_ = a2_))
  • zen-enum-surjective — forall([al in ord, s in set], not(forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, al) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})) implies forall([w in s], forsome([z in ord-segment(al)], (vnb-lambda(a_, ord-segment(al), zen(s, a_)))(z) = w)))
  • zen-exhausts — forall([s in set], forsome([alpha in ord], not(forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))}))))
  • zen-hits — forall([alpha in ord, s], forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))}) implies zen(s, alpha) in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})
  • zen-step — forall([alpha in ord, x], zen(x, alpha) = choice({y_ in x: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(x, c_) = y_))}))
  • zermelo-bijection — forall([s in set], forsome([al in ord, phi], phi in bijection(ord-segment(al), s)))
  • zermelo-least-ordinal — forall([s in set], forsome([al in ord], not(forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, al) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})) and forall([cz], ord-lt(cz, al) implies forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, cz) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))}))))
  • zero-deriv-off-countable — forall([zs_], is-countable(zs_) implies zs_ subset rr implies forall([zh_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([zx_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, zh_, zx_)) implies forall([zu_ in rr, zv_ in rr], zu_ < zv_ implies forall([zt_ in ooint(zu_, zv_)], not(zt_ in zs_) implies is-diff-at(zh_, zt_, 0)) implies zh_(zu_) = zh_(zv_))))
  • zero-deriv-off-countable-constant — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([g in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(g, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([zd_], is-countable(zd_) implies zd_ subset ccint(a, b) implies forall([zt_ in ooint(a, b)], not(zt_ in zd_) implies has-deriv-at(g, zt_, 0)) implies forall([zs_ in ccint(a, b), zw_ in ccint(a, b)], g(zs_) = g(zw_)))))
  • zero-in-rr-pos-star — 0 in rr-pos-star
  • zero-is-antiderivable — forall([a, b], a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, 0), a, b))
  • zero-seq-in-fun — vnb-lambda(n_, nn, 0) in fun(nn, rr)
  • zero-series-converges — series-converges(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, 0))
  • zeromat-entries-defined — forall([a, m, n], is-ring(a) implies m in nn implies n in nn implies forall([i_ in interval(1, m), j_ in interval(1, n)], (vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, m), interval(1, n)), zero(a)))(i_, j_) in set))
  • zeromat-type — forall([a], is-ring(a) implies forall([m, n], m in nn implies n in nn implies zeromat(a, m, n) in mat(m, n, carr(a))))
  • zorn-chain-plus-keepset — forall([phi, grd, porel, kset, alpha], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies is-chain(grd, porel, kset) implies is-chain(grd, porel, union(kset, keep-set(phi, grd, porel, kset, alpha))))
  • zorn-empty-is-chain — forall([grd, porel], grd in set implies is-chain(grd, porel, empty-set))
  • zorn-lemma — forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies forsome([w_], w_ in grd) implies forall([ch_], is-chain(grd, porel, ch_) implies forsome([u_], is-upper-bound(grd, porel, ch_, u_))) implies forsome([mx_], is-maximal(grd, porel, mx_)))
  • zorn-zkept-is-chain — forall([alpha in ord, phi, grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies is-chain(grd, porel, zkept(phi, grd, porel, alpha)))
  • zorn-zkept-limit-is-chain — forall([phi, grd, porel, lam], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies limit-ord(lam) implies forall([beta in ord-segment(lam)], is-chain(grd, porel, zkept(phi, grd, porel, beta))) implies is-chain(grd, porel, big-union(beta2, ord-segment(lam), zkept(phi, grd, porel, beta2))))
  • zorn-zkept-monotone — forall([b in ord, phi, grd, porel, a in ord], ord-le(a, b) implies zkept(phi, grd, porel, a) subset zkept(phi, grd, porel, b))
  • zup-injective — forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) and forsome([w_], w_ in grd) and forall([ch_], is-chain(grd, porel, ch_) implies forsome([u_], is-upper-bound(grd, porel, ch_, u_))) and forall([x_ in grd], forsome([y_ in grd], is-strictly-below(porel, x_, y_))) implies forall([a1_, a2_], a1_ in ord implies a2_ in ord implies zup(grd, porel, a1_) = zup(grd, porel, a2_) implies a1_ = a2_))
  • zup-tower — forall([a_ in ord, grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) and forsome([w_], w_ in grd) and forall([ch_], is-chain(grd, porel, ch_) implies forsome([u_], is-upper-bound(grd, porel, ch_, u_))) and forall([x_ in grd], forsome([y_ in grd], is-strictly-below(porel, x_, y_))) implies zup(grd, porel, a_) in grd and forall([b_], ord-lt(b_, a_) implies zup(grd, porel, b_) in grd and is-strictly-below(porel, zup(grd, porel, b_), zup(grd, porel, a_))))
  • zz-2m-neq-1 — forall([m in zz], not(2 * m = 1))

  • zz-abs-in-nn — forall([a_ in zz], abs(a_) in nn)
  • zz-act-add — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([j in zz, k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, j + k, a) = (opr(g))(zz-act(g, j, a), zz-act(g, k, a))))
  • zz-act-neg — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in nn, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, -k, a) = (inv(g))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, k))))
  • zz-act-neg-sign — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, -k, a) = (inv(g))(zz-act(g, k, a))))
  • zz-act-nonneg — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in nn, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, k, a) = mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, k)))

  • zz-act-type — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, k, a) in carr(g)))
  • zz-act-zero — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, 0, a) = iden(g)))
  • zz-add-cancel — forall([a in zz, b in zz, c in zz], a + c = b + c implies a = b)

  • zz-is-euclidean-ring — is-euclidean-ring(zz-ring)
  • zz-is-integral-domain — is-integral-domain(zz-ring)
  • zz-is-ring — is-ring(zz-ring)
  • zz-lt-succ-le — forall([a_ in zz, b_ in zz], a_ < b_ implies a_ + 1 <= b_)
  • zz-mul-cancel-zero — forall([a in zz, b in zz], a * b = 0 implies not(b = 0) implies a = 0)
  • zz-no-zero-divisors — forall([a in zz, b in zz], a * b = 0 implies a = 0 or b = 0)
  • zz-nonneg-in-nn — forall([a_ in zz], 0 <= a_ implies a_ in nn)
  • zz-not-even-and-odd — forall([x in zz], not(even(x) and odd(x)))
  • zz-odd-mul-odd — forall([x in zz, y in zz], odd(x) implies odd(y) implies odd(x * y))
  • zz-odd-sq-odd — forall([x in zz], odd(x) implies odd(x * x))
  • zz-parity — forall([a in zz], even(a) or odd(a))
  • zz-sub-in-zz — forall([u_, v_], u_ in zz implies v_ in zz implies u_ - v_ in zz)
  • zz-trichotomy — forall([a_ in zz], a_ < 0 or a_ = 0 or 0 < a_)

Results we accept without a machine proof in VNB. Logically treated as theorems.

  • absolute-summable-implies-summable — forall([grp], is-normed-ag(grp) and is-complete(nag-metric-space(grp)) implies forall([f], f in fun(dom(f), carr(grp)) and is-absolutely-summable(grp, f) implies is-summable(grp, f))) [warrant: informal]

  • integral-additive — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, g], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies integral(omega, ca, mu, ptwise-eplus(omega, f, g)) = eplus(integral(omega, ca, mu, f), integral(omega, ca, mu, g))) [warrant: reference]
  • integral-simple-approx — forall([omega, ca, f], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies forsome([cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star))], forall([n_ in nn], is-simple-fn(omega, ca, cf(n_))) and forall([n_ in nn], ptwise-le(omega, cf(n_), cf(succ(n_)))) and forall([x_ in omega], (ptwise-sup(omega, cf))(x_) = f(x_)))) [warrant: reference]

  • measurable-fn-liminf — forall([omega, ca, cf], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([n_ in nn], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, cf(n_))) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-liminf(omega, cf))) [warrant: reference]
  • measurable-fn-sup — forall([omega, ca, cf], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([n_ in nn], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, cf(n_))) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-sup(omega, cf))) [warrant: reference]

  • minkowski-l2 — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, (a(i) + b(i)) * (a(i) + b(i))), s)) <= sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * a(i)), s)) + sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, b(i) * b(i)), s)))) [warrant: well-known]

Stated without proof

Not proved in VNB; split by origin. "Axiom" is reserved for the first group — it is NOT the umbrella for this section.

Axioms — the fixed VNB base

The foundational axioms of VNB set theory (make-vnb-base-theory core + theorem-library/axioms). Fixed, though not finite (separation/replacement are schemas). Everything else rests on these.

> The axioms below are NOT the whole trusted base. The set- & class-formation schemas (separation {x∈A|p}, comprehension {x|p}, indexed union ⋃_{z∈A}body) carry a formula schema in their body and so live in the proof checker as primitive inference rules, not as formulas in this table. They are stated, with their premises and conclusions, in KERNEL-RULES.md. The trusted base is these axioms plus the kernel rules.

  • app-graph — forall([fn_, arg_], fn_(arg_) == iota(val_, [arg_, val_] in fn_))
  • apply-tupling-1 — forall([f, a], f(a) == f([a]))
  • apply-tupling-2 — forall([f, a, b], f(a, b) == f([a, b]))
  • apply-tupling-3 — forall([f, a, b, c], f(a, b, c) == f([a, b, c]))
  • burali-forti — not(ord in set)
  • cartesian-set-iff — forall([a, b], cartesian(a, b) in set iff a in set and b in set)
  • cc-add-assoc — forall([a, b, c], a in cc and b in cc and c in cc implies (a + b) + c = a + (b + c))

  • bijection-membership-iff — forall([x, y, phi], phi in bijection(x, y) iff phi in fun(x, y) and forall([a in x, b in x], phi(a) = phi(b) implies a = b) and forall([w in y], forsome([z in x], phi(z) = w)))
  • binary-divide-def — forall([a, b], (/)(a, b) == a * recip(b))
  • binary-minus-def — forall([a, b], a - b == a + -b)
  • binneg-apply — forall([x], binneg(x) == -x)

  • caratheodory-sets-membership — forall([omega, mu, es_], es_ in caratheodory-sets(omega, mu) iff es_ in power(omega) and is-caratheodory-measurable(omega, mu, es_))

  • cc-normed-field@carr — carr(cc-normed-field) == cc
  • cc-normed-field@fnrm — fnrm(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))
  • cc-normed-field@mul — mul(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ * y_)

  • cc-normed-field@zero — zero(cc-normed-field) == 0

  • cips-act-type — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v)], (act(v))(a_, x_) in vec(v)))
  • cips-ip-add-left — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v), z_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((vadd(v))(x_, y_), z_) = (ip(v))(x_, z_) + (ip(v))(y_, z_)))
  • cips-ip-conj-sym — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(y_, x_) = conjugate((ip(v))(x_, y_))))
  • cips-ip-definite — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) = 0 iff x_ = vzero(v)))
  • cips-ip-homog-left — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((act(v))(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * (ip(v))(x_, y_)))
  • cips-ip-self-nonneg — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], 0 <= (ip(v))(x_, x_)))
  • cips-ip-self-real — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) in rr))
  • cips-ip-type — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, y_) in cc))
  • cips-ip-zero-vector — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(v)))
  • cips-scal-carrier — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies carr(scal(v)) = cc)
  • cips-vadd-type — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (vadd(v))(x_, y_) in vec(v)))
  • cips-vadd-vzero — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (vadd(v))(vzero(v), x_) = x_))
  • cips-vzero-in — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies vzero(v) in vec(v))
  • cluster-point — forall([s, f, x], cluster-point(s, f, x) iff is-metric-space(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and x in pts(s) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forall([m in nn], forsome([n in nn], m <= n and (dist(s))(f(n), x) < eps))))
  • comb-kk-succ — forall([r, x, y, m in nn], comb-kk(r, x, y, succ(m)) == vnb-lambda(k, zz, (add(r))((mul(r))(x, (comb-kk(r, x, y, m))(k - 1)), (mul(r))(y, (comb-kk(r, x, y, m))(k)))))
  • comb-kk-zero — forall([r, x, y], comb-kk(r, x, y, 0) == vnb-lambda(k, zz, if(k = 0, one(r), zero(r))))
  • comm-monoid-class — forall([s], s in comm-monoid iff is-comm-monoid(s))
  • commutative-ring-additive-ag-is-abelian-group — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies is-abelian-group(commutative-ring-additive-ag(r)))
  • commutative-ring-additive-ag-is-abelian-group-normed-field-as-commutative-ring — forall([r], is-normed-field(r) implies is-abelian-group(commutative-ring-additive-ag(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(r))))
  • commutative-ring-class — forall([s], s in commutative-ring iff is-commutative-ring(s))
  • commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm-is-comm-monoid — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies is-comm-monoid(commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm(r)))

  • complete-cauchy-converges — forall([s], is-complete(s) implies forall([f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) implies converges(s, f)))
  • complex-inner-product-space-as-module-is-module — forall([r], is-complex-inner-product-space(r) implies is-module(complex-inner-product-space-as-module(r)))
  • complex-inner-product-space-class — forall([s], s in complex-inner-product-space iff is-complex-inner-product-space(s))
  • cons-in-tuples — forall([a, x, l], x in a and l in tuples(a) implies cons(x, l) in tuples(a))
  • converges — forall([s, f], converges(s, f) iff forsome([l], converges-to(s, f, l)))
  • converges-along — forall([s, g, b, p], converges-along(s, g, b, p) iff is-metric-space(s) and g in fun(nn, pts(s)) and p in pts(s) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([i in nn], i in b implies n <= i implies (dist(s))(g(i), p) <= eps))))
  • converges-on — forall([s, fam, dseq], converges-on(s, fam, dseq) iff is-metric-space(s) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) and dseq in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([m in nn], converges(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fam(k))(dseq(m))))))
  • converges-to — forall([s, f, l], converges-to(s, f, l) iff is-metric-space(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and l in pts(s) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([n_ in nn], n <= n_ implies (dist(s))(f(n_), l) <= eps))))
  • converges-uniformly — forall([s, seq, g], converges-uniformly(s, seq, g) iff is-metric-space(s) and seq in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) and g in fun(pts(s), rr) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([k], k in nn and cap <= k implies forall([x in pts(s)], abs((seq(k))(x) - g(x)) < eps)))))
  • cseq-equiv — forall([m, f, g], cseq-equiv(m, f, g) iff converges-to(rr-ms, dist-seq(m, f, g), 0))
  • dc-iter-succ — forall([s, a, nxt, n in nn], dc-iter(s, a, nxt, succ(n)) == choice({y_ in s: y_ in nxt(n, dc-iter(s, a, nxt, n))}))
  • dc-iter-zero — forall([s, a, nxt], dc-iter(s, a, nxt, 0) == a)
  • deg-bound — forall([a, p, n], deg-bound(a, p, n) iff forall([k_ in nn], n < k_ implies p(k_) = zero(a)))
  • det-cofactor — forall([r, n, a], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies a in mat(succ(n), succ(n), carr(r)) implies det(r, succ(n), a) == finsum(ring-additive-ag(r), vnb-lambda(j, interval(1, succ(n)), (mul(r))(mpow(ring-multiplicative-monoid(r), (neg(r))(one(r)), succ(j)), (mul(r))(entry(a, 1, j), det(r, n, minor(a, 1, j, n))))), interval(1, succ(n))))
  • det-zero — forall([r, a], det(r, 0, a) == one(r))
  • dual-carrier — forall([m], vec(dual(m)) == dual-vec(m))

  • ell-two-def — ell-two = {x_ in sqn(cc): series-converges(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, magnitude(x_(k_)) * magnitude(x_(k_))))}

  • etimes-def — etimes == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr-pos-star, rr-pos-star), if(x_ = pos-inf or y_ = pos-inf, if(x_ = 0 or y_ = 0, 0, pos-inf), bintimes(x_, y_)))
  • euclidean-ring-class — forall([s], s in euclidean-ring iff is-euclidean-ring(s))
  • even — forall([x], even(x) iff forsome([k in zz], x = 2 * k))

  • finsum-single-support-ring-additive-ag — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(r)), i0 in s], forall([j in s], not(j = i0) implies f(j) = zero(r)) implies finsum(ring-additive-ag(r), f, s) = f(i0))))
  • finsum-type-ring-additive-ag — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(r))], finsum(ring-additive-ag(r), f, s) in carr(r))))
  • fr-cauchy — forall([m, fam, seq], fr-cauchy(m, fam, seq) iff forall([k in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i], i in nn and cap <= i implies forall([j], j in nn and cap <= j implies (fam(k))((vadd(m))(seq(i), (vneg(m))(seq(j)))) < eps)))))
  • fr-conv — forall([m, fam, seq, lim], fr-conv(m, fam, seq, lim) iff forall([k in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i], i in nn and cap <= i implies (fam(k))((vadd(m))(seq(i), (vneg(m))(lim))) < eps))))
  • generates — forall([md, n, u], generates(md, n, u) iff forall([x_ in vec(md)], forsome([c_ in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md)))], x_ = lincomb(md, n, c_, u))))

  • group-class — forall([s], s in group iff is-group(s))
  • has-closed-graph — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], has-closed-graph(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) iff is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) and forall([seq in fun(nn, vec(m1)), p1 in vec(m1), p2 in vec(m2)], fr-conv(m1, fam1, seq, p1) and fr-conv(m2, fam2, vnb-lambda(i, nn, tt(seq(i))), p2) implies p2 = tt(p1)))
  • has-deriv-at — forall([f, a, l], has-deriv-at(f, a, l) iff forsome([ice_], pos-rr(ice_) and is-diff-on(rr-normed-field, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_), restrict(f, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_)), a, l)))
  • has-deriv-at-within — forall([f, w, x, l], has-deriv-at-within(f, w, x, l) iff restrict(f, w) in fun(w, rr) and x in w and l in rr and forsome([osp_ in fun(w, rr)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, w), rr-ms, osp_, x) and osp_(x) = l and forall([ost_ in w], f(ost_) - f(x) = osp_(ost_) * (ost_ - x))))
  • has-div-remainder — forall([s, dg], has-div-remainder(s, dg) iff forall([a_ in carr(s), b in carr(s)], not(b = zero(s)) implies forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)], a_ = (add(s))((mul(s))(q, b), r) and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b)))))
  • has-fip — forall([s, c], has-fip(s, c) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([a0], a0 in c) and forall([a in c], is-closed(s, a)) and forall([f], f subset c implies card(f) in nn implies forsome([a0], a0 in f) implies forsome([p], p in intersection-of(f))))
  • has-inverses — forall([op, unit, invop, crr], has-inverses(op, unit, invop, crr) iff forall([u in crr], op(invop(u), u) = unit and op(u, invop(u)) = unit))
  • has-left-deriv-at — forall([f, x, l], has-left-deriv-at(f, x, l) iff forsome([ose_], pos-rr(ose_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, ocint(x - ose_, x), x, l)))
  • has-right-deriv-at — forall([f, x, l], has-right-deriv-at(f, x, l) iff forsome([ose_], pos-rr(ose_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, coint(x, x + ose_), x, l)))
  • holomorphic-on — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) iff is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) and f in fun(u, cc) and forall([a in u], forsome([l], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, a, l))))

  • injection-membership-iff — forall([x, y, phi], phi in injection(x, y) iff phi in fun(x, y) and forall([a in x, b in x], phi(a) = phi(b) implies a = b))
  • injective-star — forall([f], injective-star(f) iff forall([u_, v_], f(u_) = f(v_) implies u_ = v_))

  • ip-normed-ag-norm-value — forall([v, x in vec(v)], (nrm(ip-normed-ag(v)))(x) == ip-norm(v, x))
  • is-abelian-group — forall([s], is-abelian-group(s) iff length(s) = 4 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)))
  • is-absolutely-summable — forall([grp, f], is-absolutely-summable(grp, f) iff esum(vnb-lambda(i, dom(f), (nrm(grp))(f(i)))) in rr)
  • is-algebra-of-sets — forall([omega, ca], is-algebra-of-sets(omega, ca) iff omega in set and ca subset power(omega) and forsome([a_], a_ in ca) and forall([a_ in ca], complement-in(omega, a_) in ca) and forall([a_ in ca, b_ in ca], union(a_, b_) in ca) and forall([a_ in ca, b_ in ca], intersection(a_, b_) in ca))
  • is-analytic-at — forall([anlf_, anlu_, anla_], is-analytic-at(anlf_, anlu_, anla_) iff is-open(cc-ms, anlu_) and anlf_ in fun(anlu_, cc) and anla_ in anlu_ and forsome([anlcf_ in fun(nn, cc), anlr_ in rr], 0 < anlr_ and anlr_ < cps-radius(anlcf_) and ball(cc-ms, anla_, anlr_) subset anlu_ and forall([anlz_ in ball(cc-ms, anla_, anlr_)], anlf_(anlz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(anlk_, nn, anlcf_(anlk_) * (anlz_ - anla_) ^ anlk_)))))

  • is-associative — forall([op, crr], is-associative(op, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], op(op(u, v), w) = op(u, op(v, w))))
  • is-bounded-linear-arrow-def — forall([a, b, f], is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forsome([blk_ in rr], 0 <= blk_ and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(b))(f(x1_)) <= blk_ * (vnrm(a))(x1_))))
  • is-bounded-linear-functional — forall([m, f], is-bounded-linear-functional(m, f) iff is-linear-functional(m, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in vec(m)], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))
  • is-bounded-linear-functional-on — forall([m, s, f], is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) iff is-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in s], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))
  • is-bounded-metric-space — forall([s], is-bounded-metric-space(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([b in rr], forall([x, y], x in pts(s) implies y in pts(s) implies (dist(s))(x, y) <= b)))

  • is-hom-setoid-def — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-setoid(a, b, f) iff is-setoid(a) and is-setoid(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in pts(a), x2_ in pts(a)], [x1_, x2_] in rel(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in rel(b)))

  • is-ideal — forall([s, i], is-ideal(s, i) iff is-commutative-ring(s) and i subset carr(s) and zero(s) in i and forall([a in i, b in i], (add(s))(a, b) in i) and forall([a in i], (neg(s))(a) in i) and forall([r in carr(s), a in i], (mul(s))(r, a) in i))
  • is-ideal-in — forall([i_, carr_, add_, mul_, neg_, zero_], is-ideal-in(i_, carr_, add_, mul_, neg_, zero_) iff i_ subset carr_ and zero_ in i_ and forall([a, b], a in i_ implies b in i_ implies add_(a, b) in i_) and forall([a in i_], neg_(a) in i_) and forall([x_, a], x_ in carr_ implies a in i_ implies mul_(x_, a) in i_) and forall([x_, a], x_ in carr_ implies a in i_ implies mul_(a, x_) in i_))

  • is-left-limit — forall([f, x, l], is-left-limit(f, x, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and x in rr and l in rr and forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([t_], t_ in rr and x - delta_ <= t_ and t_ < x implies abs(f(t_) - l) <= eps_))))

  • is-measurable-space — forall([s], is-measurable-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and sigma(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and is-sigma-algebra(pts(s), sigma(s)))
  • is-measure — forall([omega, ca, mu], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and mu in fun(ca, rr-pos-star) and mu(empty-set) = 0 and forall([f_ in fun(nn, ca)], forall([i_, j_], i_ in nn implies j_ in nn implies not(i_ = j_) implies intersection(f_(i_), f_(j_)) = empty-set) implies mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) = esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))))))

  • is-monoid — forall([s], is-monoid(s) iff length(s) = 3 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)))

  • is-normed-ag — forall([s], is-normed-ag(s) iff length(s) = 5 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and nrm(s) in fun(carr(s), rr) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-group-norm(nrm(s), opr(s), inv(s), iden(s), carr(s)))
  • is-normed-field — forall([s], is-normed-field(s) iff length(s) = 7 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and fnrm(s) in fun(carr(s), rr) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and is-norm(fnrm(s), add(s), mul(s), zero(s), carr(s)))
  • is-normed-vector-space — forall([s], is-normed-vector-space(s) iff length(s) = 7 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vnrm(s) in fun(vec(s), rr) and is-associative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-commutative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-identity(vadd(s), vzero(s), vec(s)) and has-inverses(vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), vec(s)) and scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(r_, (vadd(s))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(r_, y_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((add(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((mul(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (act(s))(r_, (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= (vnrm(s))(x_)) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))(x_) = 0 iff x_ = vzero(s)) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((act(s))(r_, x_)) = abs(r_) * (vnrm(s))(x_)) and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((vadd(s))(x_, y_)) <= (vnrm(s))(x_) + (vnrm(s))(y_)))
  • is-nowhere-dense — forall([s, a], is-nowhere-dense(s, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and a subset pts(s) and interior(s, closure(s, a)) = empty-set)

  • is-outer-measure — forall([omega, mu], is-outer-measure(omega, mu) iff omega in set and mu in fun(power(omega), rr-pos-star) and mu(empty-set) = 0 and forall([a_, b_], a_ in power(omega) implies b_ in power(omega) implies a_ subset b_ implies mu(a_) <= mu(b_)) and forall([f_ in fun(nn, power(omega))], mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) <= esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))))))
  • is-partial-order — forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) iff grd in set and porel in set and forall([x in grd], [x, x] in porel) and forall([x in grd, y in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, x] in porel implies x = y) and forall([x in grd, y in grd, z in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, z] in porel implies [x, z] in porel))
  • is-partition — forall([p, n, a, b], is-partition(p, n, a, b) iff n in nn and 1 <= n and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and p in fun(nn, rr) and p(0) = a and p(n) = b and forall([i_, j_], i_ in interval(0, n) and j_ in interval(0, n) and i_ < j_ implies p(i_) < p(j_)))
